records.title: Birth centenary celebrations
details:
(b) 
A commemorative centenary seminar is going to be organized by Sahitya Akademi, 
Ministry of Culture in collaboration with the Bishop Heber College, Tiruchirappalli, on

records.title: TAIL-STRIKE INCIDENT AT CHENNAI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
details:
(a) to (d): On 08.03.2025,
M/s Indigo aircraft was
involved in tail strike incident
at Chennai. The occurrence
is classified as serious
incident by Aircraft Accident
Investigation Bureau (AAIB).
The investigation is under
progress. The report will be
published on AAIB
website with the conclusion
drawn.
